about: The secreta of the formulary “First Passion Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, O Lord, may these gifts both loose the bonds of our perversity and obtain for us the gifts of Your mercy. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: may loose the bonds of our perversity
may obtain for us the gifts of Your mercy
who lives and reigns with You
